instruction.name: xvfcmp.cor.d
instruction.description: Compare corresponding double precision elements in `a` and `b`, save the comparison result (all ones if OR(Ordered), all zeros otherwise) into `dst`. No exception is raised for QNaN.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Dependent vector-mask chain. Sources are normal float values 1.0 and 2.0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfcmp.cor.d $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvfcmp.cor.d $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvfcmp.cor.d $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvfcmp.cor.d $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvfcmp.cor.d $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvfcmp.cor.d $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvfcmp.cor.d $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvfcmp.cor.d $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
